give me study material for Orchestration Patterns

Hey! I don't have the official "Claude Certified Architect - Foundations" syllabus memorized, so I won't invent cert-specific details. But I can share orchestration patterns that commonly appear in architecture foundations exams, along with how to study them effectively for this type of test.

**Core patterns to focus on:**
- **Orchestration vs. Choreography**: Orchestration has a central coordinator (e.g., workflow engine, API gateway); choreography is peer-to-peer event-driven. Know when each simplifies vs. complicates your system.
- **Saga Pattern**: Handles distributed transactions via a sequence of local commits/ compensating actions. Study the "orchestrated saga" (central coordinator) vs. "choreographed saga" (event-driven) trade-offs.
- **API Gateway + Routing**: Central entry point for request orchestration, protocol translation, and offloading
